frame_indexing: Zero-based decoded source frames. Intervals are [start,end); source is 29.97003 fps, not exactly 30.
method: Entire video inspected at 6 fps; every source frame 360–1364 inspected in 34 sheets. Full-resolution selected frames and intro/outro boundaries inspected separately. No hit count inferred from audio peaks.
measurement_limits: Body heights and hex colors are visual estimates, not world coordinates or sampled material values. Camera zoom changes pixel distances. No combat HUD or skill title labels; kit mapping is inferred.
name: Mind Whip
variant: Group presentation, possible Indiscriminate / Unfocused Volley
mapping_evidence: Three short beam releases plus one sustained beam after overhead recharge. Four distinct main hit beats match the four-coin skill. Both presentations share the same choreography.
variant_confidence: low: numerical Charge, damage distribution and Unfocused Volley cannot be established without HUD

weapon.type: Cable-connected mechanical energy rod / prod with a rectangular emitter head; exact in-world weapon designation not readable
weapon.parts: Long narrow dark segmented shaft; chunky rectangular black head with pale gold/orange inset strips, squared collars, dark flexible cable curving back toward carried equipment. No visible cutting edge or spear point.
weapon.held: Two hands on the shaft during braced sweeps/aiming; raised one-handed overhead during channel poses, free hand lower near waist. Not shouldered like an ordinary rifle.
weapon.qualification: Staff-like silhouette is descriptive only. Golden crescents and orb are temporary energy effects, not a permanent blade or lantern.
weapon.skill_use: Same cable-connected mechanical rod used as an energy emitter. Held in two-handed braced aim, raised overhead during recharge, then aimed through long beam channel.

props.path: rings circulate locally; beam connects emitter to target
props.count: four main beam releases; one connected line at a time with occasional trail double

props.origin: Already in group formation at 22.556; not spawned by attack

beats.observation: Rodion runs low toward firing position; camera follows.
Rod circles body inside gold segmented rings; target is not hit.
Feet braced; emitter points right with small bright orb.
Abrupt muzzle bloom and close-up; target contact becomes visible as camera opens.
Connected gold beam, purple/orange target ring; muzzle circle contracts.
New expanded segmented muzzle ring and gold beam; repeated target annulus.
Third distinct muzzle-ring burst; beam persists briefly, then fades.
Large upward crescent; weapon goes overhead, no target hit.
Orbiting gold strips and particles around torso and raised emitter.
Small orb above hand, root planted.
Broad diagonal sweep; tight caster shot with reddish afterimage. Does not reach target.
Orb grows, angular lightning and needles expand around emitter.
Fast punch, beam extends to right.
Long beam flickers, small repeated impact-ring pulses; do not count each as a coin.
Muzzle blooms into one more segmented ring while beam remains connected; then beam thins and vanishes.
Caster lowers into extended low stance; embers remain.
No new target strike or separate defense; hold until editorial cut.
